issues.description: Element: SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal). Problem statement: explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared across all instances). Solution & template: the reference implementation (SealSaloon.java) declares calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)) and both Main.java examples call it via an instance (shop.calculateTotalPrice(...)). This inconsistency (static required vs. instance implementation and usage) will confuse students about the intended design and could cause test/spec mismatch.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended design consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the SealSaloon implementation and example usages to make calculateTotalPrice a static method (declare: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)) and update calls to SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal), or (B) revise the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice must be static so the instance method in the solution and template is accepted. Apply the chosen approach to the problem statement, the reference solution (SealSaloon.java), and the example usages (Main.java).
